thread:
jules: Quick sync — pinwheel launch social plan. Need X + LinkedIn schedule, hero image variants, 2 short threads (bench narrative + webinar tease), and inbound lead routing for the webinar on May 15. Draft timeline below.

maria: got it. timeline?

jules: Week of May 6: teaser posts. May 10: benchmark thread (results highlight). May 13: webinar registration push + reminder on the 14th. On the day: live thread + post-event recap.

kevin: tagging @maria for assets — can design hero variants by Tue? need 3 sizes: X card, LI banner, thumbnail.

maria: I can do two static + one animated. will need final copy by EOD Fri.

jules: copy drafts below — please iterate: 
- Teaser (X): "We halved inference latency for gen workloads — join our webinar May 15 to see how. Register → {shortlink}"
- Benchmark thread (X): 3 tweets: 1) headline + CTA, 2) micro-bench numbers + chart, 3) tl;dr + register link
- LinkedIn (longer): problem -> approach -> result -> webinar CTA

anshul: for benchmark thread, can we use the new p99 latency chart? also include a short note on quantization tradeoffs.

kevin: yes, will export a clean PNG. maria — do you want the chart raw or stylized?

maria: stylized to our grid. keep it legible at tweet size.

sasha: inbound routing — how are we handling registrants? want SDR handoff or automated nurture?

jules: plan A: direct qualified leads to SDR queue (region-based). Plan B: everyone else gets nurture sequence (3 emails + one LinkedIn follow-up). Need tagging rules.

anshul: proposed tagging: company size >1000 OR target vertical in form -> sdq_region tag, else nurture. Also capture 'benchmark_interest' boolean.

sasha: can the registration form push to HubSpot with those fields?

kevin: yes — I'll wire the form mapping. @launch-bot can we get a reminder 48h before copy freeze?

launch-bot: Reminder scheduled — copy freeze in 48 hours (at 4912523070).

maria: copy draft v1 attached to this thread: short + long variations. @jules can you review before I start the hero comps?

jules: reviewing now. quick notes: make the headline punchier, shorten CTA to "Register" for X. For LI, highlight a customer case snippet.

kevin: timeline check — assets ready Tue, scheduling slots done Wed, form live Thu. Good?

jules: good. Sasha, please confirm SDR coverage for 48h post-webinar and timezone overlaps (EMEA morning coverage).

sasha: confirmed — EMEA overlap handled, SDR rota updated.

maria: will upload hero variants to /marketing/assets/pinwheel by Mon evening.

anshul: one more: benchmark thread needs an alt-data blurb for folks who want the raw table. add a link to the results repo.

jules: perfect. i'll finalize copy and push to the scheduling doc. thanks team :rocket:
